integrity: An analytic all-dimension proof is supplied. A standard-library exhaustive finite checker is supplied and independently replayable for orders six and seven; computational evidence is not a substitute for the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the support-at-most-five regime and three disjoint transpositions are classified, not all weighted distances or diameter; historical priority has not been independently established.
title: The first nonadditive Euclidean skeleton geodesics of the Birkhoff polytope
